scope: A 100-standard-occupation name-only API trial; it is not a full mapping run.

input.api_privacy_scope: API inputs contain only standard_occupation_id, standard_name, and frozen taxonomy directory. No company, industry, recruitment prose, skills, atomic IDs, or source record IDs are sent.

manual_audit.method: Each of 100 titles was independently reviewed by Codex; no default verdicts or generated templates were used.

integrity.atomic_links_note: The sample output joins v4 by standard_occupation_id; all original group, atomic-role, and source-record links remain only in the read-only v4 input.

known_issue_and_fix.raw_v2_review_parent_ids: The first v2 prompt incorrectly derived some parent IDs by splitting slash-containing level-1 labels, so affected review targets are preserved as raw outputs and are not formal mappings.
known_issue_and_fix.future_runner_fix: The runner now derives level-2 parents by removing only the final level-3 ID segment and takes level-1 IDs from the frozen level-1 label.
